sn35.101:1.1: Yam pi bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ tam pajahatha ||
sn35.101:1.2: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || || 3
sn35.101:1.6: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || ||
sn35.101:1.9: te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti || ||
sn35.101:1.12: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || ||
sn35.101:1.15: so vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || ||
sn35.101:1.16: Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi na tumhākaṃ
sn35.101:1.18: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati ||

sn35.101:2.14: tam pajahatha || taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || || la || || 9

sn35.101:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yam imasmiṃ Jetavane tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ taṃ jano hareyya vā ḍaheyya vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā kareyya ||
sn35.101:4.3: Amhe jano harati vā ḍahati vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā karotī ti || ||
sn35.101:7.1: Na hi no hetam bhante attā vā attaniyaṃ vā ti || || 11-16
sn35.101:8.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave cakkhu na tumhākaṃ
sn35.101:8.3: taṃ vo pahīnam hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || ||
